meta.description: Registry for reduction-step legality and preservation conditions in Phase 3.

legality_conditions.name: participation_preservation
legality_conditions.description: Reduction must not eliminate participating loci required for the next operator application.

legality_conditions.name: residue_legality_preservation
legality_conditions.description: Reduction must preserve residue-state equivalence and conditioning roles.

legality_conditions.name: non_null_continuation
legality_conditions.description: Reduction must ensure that continuation candidate sets remain non-empty where existence is required.

legality_conditions.name: orientation_compatibility
legality_conditions.description: Reduction must maintain alignment with the local orientation frame or minimization rules.

legality_conditions.name: branch_pruning_stability
legality_conditions.description: Reduction must remain within declared branch-width and pruning bounds.
